newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel premiums steady in scattered trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel premiums steady in scattered trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were around unchanged in scattered volumes on Tuesday, traders said.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures slipped $2.50 to $213 a tonne, helped lower by Brent's NYMEX-led fall and European Union data showing higher distillate stocks.
Barge premiums were about Dec IPE +$24 fob ARA for prompt and Jan +$24 for second half December. Cargo premiums were notionally Dec IPE +$35 cif NWE with fob NWE quoted at basis Jan +$25/26.
In the Med, premiums were around fob Med high +$5/7. Traders reported Tunisian and French demand for cargoes in combination with gasoline and gas oil. Interest emerged for dual purpose kerosene.
